topic: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after brief resignation
title: Nvidia Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO on November 23 2026
dek: The board returned Jensen Huang to his roles after a brief resignation tied to an affair scandal, with support from President Trump and no national security concerns.
body:
Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as president, chief executive and board director on November 23, 2026. The move reversed his resignation from less than two weeks earlier, which had stemmed from an affair scandal. That situation involved Alice Huang, whom US intelligence suspected of links to Chinese spying. The earlier departure had raised questions about compliance practices and intelligence ties at the company.

President Trump publicly backed the reinstatement and reportedly influenced the board's decision. Officials described the choice as essential to the company's continued success and to broader economic stability. The US government assessed that Huang's return carried no national security risk. The board highlighted his renewed commitment as a central reason for the reversal of the mid-November leadership change.

Nvidia shares rose sharply after the announcement. Markets viewed the outcome as a positive signal of restored stability. Huang issued a statement that conveyed humility regarding the events.

## Context for the Leadership Shift

The brief resignation had created uncertainty for a major technology firm. The rapid reinstatement addressed that uncertainty while incorporating the findings of the government review. Observers noted the board's emphasis on operational continuity in its public explanation.
